doc.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Final thanks and goodbyes between Rowe and Lion.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Is there anything that you would like to add about the Blue Note experience or that I haven’t touched upon?
No, you have been so wonderful to bring out Blue Note today for me, and I think there’s nothing I can add except thank you, very much.

Well it’s been a real pleasure for me, and I appreciated being interviewed the other day too and we’ll probably just both look at these tapes. It’s been a real enjoyable trip out to San Diego here. And you know, San Diego has some good musicians itself.
Yes. And I’ve managed to meet some of them so it’s been a wonderful experience, and a great pleasure to meet you. So thank you very much.
